Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the southwest of Iceland with a ridge to Biscay.


##Wind##

West soon backing southwest, 3 or 4 increasing 4 or 5 for a time later today, becoming mostly variable 3 or less tonight.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight becoming smooth or slight later in the period


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, imminently settling east or southeast, soon backing east or northeast, then increasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional, patchy light rain developing later Sunday evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in places later.
